name: Hiroki Tanaka
bio:
Hiroki Tanaka's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for engineering and speed, fueled by watching Formula One races late into the night. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, before joining a small Super GT team as a data analyst. His sharp analytical skills quickly led to a promotion to race strategist. He spent several years honing his skills in Super GT, learning to make split-second decisions under immense pressure. 

Tanaka-san is known for his meticulous preparation and data-driven approach. He believes in thorough analysis of track conditions, competitor performance, and weather patterns to formulate optimal race strategies. His calm demeanor and ability to communicate effectively with the drivers make him a valuable asset to any team. His move to the Hansen World RX Team represents a new challenge, one where he hopes to apply his strategic acumen to the unpredictable world of rallycross.

What sets Tanaka-san apart is his ability to blend technical expertise with creative problem-solving. He is always looking for innovative ways to gain a competitive edge, whether through optimizing tire strategies or adapting to unexpected circumstances on the track. His commitment to perfection ensures that no detail is overlooked in the pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Hiroki is of average height with a slender build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of green tea before every race.
